notes: The full-text mortality counts and assigned-arm denominators match all four served slots directly; no summation or percentage-based reconstruction is needed. The held NCT02444988 registry results describe the medical ICU subset and report 418 deaths among 2735 Balanced Crystalloid participants and 467 among 2646 0.9% Sodium Chloride (Saline) participants, rather than the whole-trial counts. NCT02547779 registry results are NOT_IN_PACKET. The trial randomized ICU fluid assignment by month, and analyses were conducted at the level of each patient’s hospitalization in an intention-to-treat fashion; discharged patients could enroll again upon readmission. Lactated Ringer’s solution and Plasma-Lyte A were evaluated together in the balanced-crystalloids arm.
